services.name: 1/2 Day  Fishing Trips
services.desc: Join us today for an exciting half day fishing trip on the sparkling Southern California waters just outside Dana Point Harbor! services.name: Champagne & Sunset Sail on the Schooner Curlew
services.desc: Curlew, one of Orange County’s oldest and most beautiful yachts, is now offering 2 hour romantic sunset champagne sails on the magnificent waters off Dana Point. A 1926 classic, this romantic schooner will introduce you to the luxury & thrill of sailing as it used to be. Experience her your way. Come to relax or try your hand at schooner sailing. Avid sailor and land lubbers’ alike can choose between helping the crew hoist her 1,700 sq feet of canvas or kicking back as the professional crew takes you on a magnificent journey under sail. Per Person - $95 On your 2 hour sail, One of Orange County’s oldest and most beautiful yachts!

CANCELLATION POLICY If you cancel your charter, you must notify Dana Wharf, IN WRITING.
Cancel 60 or more days prior to your charter’s scheduled date and you will receive a full refund of the 50% deposit.
Cancellations received less than 60 days prior to the departure date are subject to forfeiture of total deposit.
WEATHER POLICY DANA WHARF vessels go out rain or shine.
If Dana Wharf cancels the trip, based on the captain’s call, due to weather, we will try to re-schedule the trip.
If this is not possible, we will issue a full refund.
If the client cancels the trip, no refund will be issued.

faq.q: What kind of whales have been recently sighted?
faq.a: This Seasons Sightings: Gray Whales, Humpback Whales, Fin Whales, Minke Whales Dolphin Sightings include Common Dolphin, Pacific White Sided Dolphin, Bottlenose Dolphin Please note that there is NO better time for seeing whales or dolphin as they pass by 24 hours/day!
